title: pm-engineering-1on1-prep-2026-03-04
content:
Context: 1:1 between PM (Avery Kim) and Eng Lead (Diego Morales). Goal: align on priorities for the next two sprints across API, Console, Dedicated, Private; unblock impediments; agree owners and deadlines. Meeting time: 2026-03-04 10:00am PT (30m).

Agenda:
- Quick sync (2–3m): wins/blockers
- API: rate limiting changes, quota migration plan, telemetry gaps (10m)
- Console: rollout plan for new rollout UI, paging/route visualization, telemetry parity with Hosted API (7m)
- Dedicated: capacity autoscaling bug, SLA review with sales requests (5m)
- Private: customer onboarding checklist for VPC install, KMS integration blockers (5m)
- Action review & next steps (3m)

Notes / talking points:
- API: need to finalize schema for quota migration. Diego: engineering prefers feature-flagged rollout; product needs soft-deprecation UX. Risk: existing customers will have hard failures if we flip before extends. Ask: can we add a limited-time compatibility shim? Samira to scope effort.
- Telemetry: token-level latency breakdown missing for batch endpoints. Matt's team has a patch but needs infra infra changes (ENG-4821). Pressure from SRE to get traces into observability pipeline.
- Console: beta feedback: users ask for per-route latency curves and ability to pin a model version per route. Prioritize per-route pinning MVP for Dedicated customers first.
- Dedicated: autoscaler bug (spins up too many pods under burst); causes OOM on older node types. Diego suspects race condition in eviction logic. Hotfix candidate vs long-term fix — decision: hotfix for patch release, schedule root-cause in next sprint.
- Private: VPC installer fails on subnet tag validation for GCP-only customers. Blocker for two pilots. Escalate to onboarding lead (Samira) and infra.

Open questions:
- Timeline for quota migration UX (PM asks 2 sprints). Engineering asks for 3 sprints if shim required.
- Can we include prefix caching metrics in console by next week? Likely no; roadmap item.

Action items:
1) Samira Qureshi: Scope compatibility shim effort for quota migration; estimate in story points and list required infra changes. Due: 2026-03-10. Status: open.
2) Diego Morales: Prepare hotfix branch for autoscaler; run regression tests against node types; deploy to staging. Due: 2026-03-06. Status: open.
3) Avery Kim: Draft communication for customers about quota migration soft-deprecation, coordinate with comms. Due: 2026-03-08. Status: open.
4) Matt Chen (observability): Finalize telemetry patch for token-level latency and coordinate deploy with SRE. Linked JIRA: ENG-4821. Due: 2026-03-12. Status: open.
5) Samira Qureshi + Infra: Triage GCP subnet tag failure for VPC installer; add regression test case. Due: 2026-03-09. Status: open.
6) Diego Morales: Add per-route pinning ticket and sizing for Dedicated customers; include UX constraints. JIRA: PM-321. Due: 2026-03-17. Status: open.

Follow-ups (for next 1:1):
- Review shim scope and decision.
- Check staging results for autoscaler hotfix.
- Validate customer communication draft.
- Prioritize per-route pinning in roadmap meeting.

Quick wins to unblock:
- Approve hotfix CI job run before EOD Friday.
- Interim message to pilots about VPC installer workaround.

Misc notes / FYI:
- Diego: hiring update — interviewing two senior infra engineers next week; potential bandwidth impact.
- PTO: Avery out 2026-03-18–2026-03-22; Diego to cover urgent decisions.

Raw links:
- Quota migration confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RND/Quota+Migration
- Autoscaler bug PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/211
- VPC installer issues doc (internal): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_private_onboard

End notes: keep this doc living; will convert to calendar invite notes and paste action items into JIRA after meeting.
